source.quote: We currently host our platform, serve our customers and support our operations in the United States using Amazon Web Services ("AWS"), a provider of cloud infrastructure services

relations.text: 買収した英Zavaを通じて提携。Asdaのサイトでオンライン診療を行い、薬はAsdaの薬局が出す
